assets.name: carry-walk-v2
assets.prompt: Create a transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows, eight full body sprites. Reference is identity and pixel art style. Top row same elf girl Aria, bottom row same brown haired boy Leon. Each row is a FOUR PHASE walking cycle facing right, EMPTY hands held forward steadily to support a separate box (do not draw box). Column 1 left leg forward heel contact, right leg stretched backward toe contact. Column 2 left leg supporting under body, RIGHT knee lifted forward passing. Column 3 RIGHT leg forward heel contact, LEFT leg stretched backward toe contact. Column 4 right leg supporting, LEFT knee lifted forward passing. Very important: alternate the forward leg, not four copies of same pose. Visible raised boot soles during passing phases. Keep exact reference head/body proportions, same head size in every cell, constant hand height, consistent outfit and detailed pixel outlines. No cropping, generous transparent gutters, no text, no shadows, no ground. 4 equal columns 2 equal rows. Characters 75% of cell height. Crisp pixel RPG sprites.

assets.name: routes-v2
assets.prompt: Create a 2x2 atlas of four equal 3:2 landscape pixel art RPG backgrounds, no seams or margins, 1536x1024. Match detailed pixel illustration style of references but camera notably MORE overhead, 60 degree downward orthographic RPG view, no horizon or sky. Small realistic landmarks and plenty of traversable ground, no characters/props/UI/text. Top left: daytime road outside medieval town at bottom left, small field plots beyond low fence, woodland farther uphill, winding path across clearing from lower left toward upper right. NO tower anywhere in this panel, no tower next to path. Top right: nighttime moonlit downhill wooded path from upper right toward lower left with distant tiny tower base only at very upper right far behind trees, lots of visible path. Bottom left and bottom right are exactly same THREE WAY Y junction geography in daylight and moonlit night respectively: broad incoming road from BOTTOM CENTER reaches fork at x50%,y65%, splits into broad clear paths going diagonally to LEFT EDGE at y25% and RIGHT EDGE at y25%. Only THREE roads. Small island of low bushes above fork, small trees well outside paths, no giant central tree blocking routes. Paths leave LEFT and RIGHT edges, not top edge. Clearly readable from high angle. Nothing obscures ground near fork and branches. Same quality as references, pixel art textures, small scale stones and plants.

assets.name: moss-jar-v1
assets.prompt: One isolated game prop, transparent background, detailed crisp pixel art matching cozy fantasy RPG sprites: a small squat clear glass specimen jar with broad neck and removable cork cap, simple thin twine loop around neck, a small natural leafy green moss tuft on moist soil inside. Three quarter slightly overhead view. Subtle pale green glow only on moss leaves, no bright glowing balls, no magic symbols or sparkles, no pedestal. Jar readable at 40px, dark warm outline, full jar entirely inside canvas with transparent padding, no other objects or characters, no text, no shadow background.

revision.prompt: Edit this sprite sheet only. Keep four equal columns and two rows, exact characters, full bodies, pixel style, transparent background. Fix walking cycle: columns 1 and 3 must be OPPOSITE STRIDES, columns 2 and 4 OPPOSITE PASSING poses. In column THREE swap the LEGS front/back: foreground leg reaches BACK to the left with toe touching, background leg extends FORWARD to the right heel touching. In column FOUR the foreground leg bends BACK with heel lifted near buttock and knee under hip; background supporting leg stands straight under body. Column TWO reduce high marching knee to a modest passing step (knee below hands). Keep upper body, face, hands at same height, SAME HEAD SIZE AND BODY HEIGHT, anchored full body feet, generous gutters and no cropped toes. No boxes, no props, no text. Do NOT simply duplicate column1 into3 or2 into4.

notes: v3 carry adopted; v2 retained as intermediate. Canon geography unchanged; branch endpoints are scene composition, not cardinal directions.
